name: final-cache

serve.command: exec env -i HOME=/home/spark USER=spark LOGNAME=spark PATH=/usr/local/cuda/bin:/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin RUST_BACKTRACE=1 /home/spark/inkling-2-mini-1x-dgx-spark/bin/rexl3-serve --model /home/spark/models/Inkling-2-Mini-SAGE-REXL3-4.23bpw --max-model-len 262144 --slots 4 --kv-tokens 1048576 --prefill-chunk 4096 --kv-dtype int8 --spec dspark --prefix-cache on --allow-unvalidated-pack --served-model-name inkling-2-mini-1x-dgx-spark --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000

tests.filter: cached == uncached, cold and warm (5 prompts up to 73168 tokens, 2 shared-prefix pairs)
0 cached tokens on every uncached and cold reply
the warm reply is served from the cache where the prompt reaches the smallest cut
the second reply of a shared-prefix pair is served from the cache

commands: ./inkling2mini.sh bench all   (gate cache: bench/tools/gates.py cache, prefix cache on, vision on, drafter on)
notes: Boot g, shipping defaults (prefix cache on, 16 entries, vision on, drafter on). gates.py cache: per prompt an uncached reference, then cold and warm with the cache; two shared-prefix pairs; 128 greedy tokens each. The with-images cache gate is the record cache-images.
